divergence_justification: Accepted 65/1,639,514 (0.004%) keyed charttime conflicts caused by irreversible DST normalization in mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_specimen_lab.sql:9,18,58 and mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_observation_labevents.sql:15,121. Normalized 02:xx and genuine 03:xx values are indistinguishable in Specimen.collection.collectedDateTime and Observation.effectiveDateTime; no other FHIR field preserves source charttime. The candidate correctly uses TIMESTAMP_NTZ and reproduces every other row and value.
